nsrr_policy.summary: GUI roadmap metadata describes GUI presentation objects and target relationships only. It does not transfer runtime, execution, persistence, provider, chart, analysis, or trading ownership.
rules: GUI owns windows, dialogs, panels, menus, buttons, inputs, tables, labels, shell layout, local dummy display state, and GUI action observation wiring.
Core owns runtime foundation, registries, lifecycle primitives, state, audit, and generic action observation infrastructure.
Domain suites own domain behavior. GUI metadata may target a suite or module but must not execute that target behavior.
Runtime Manager remains generic and read-only.
AI agents may use stable GUI IDs to request GUI interactions through approved channels, but they must not call domain internals directly.

status_taxonomy.meaning: A V2 GUI surface exists and has functional GUI-local behavior within its declared owner boundary.
A V2 GUI shell exists with local presentation or dummy display behavior only.
A GUI surface is planned but no implemented V2 window exists yet.
The domain behavior belongs to a later explicitly scoped phase and is not implemented by GUI metadata.
The item may be useful as reference material but is not active V2 source truth.
The item was intentionally removed from active V2 and must not be reintroduced without a new audit.
The item is not part of the production GUI roadmap for the current V2 phase.

gui_owns: layout, labels, status areas, tables, and inputs
core_owns: generic action and window observation contracts
ai_agent_rules: Agents may reference GUI object IDs and action IDs.
Agents may request GUI interactions only through approved GUI/action channels.
Agents must not bypass GUI boundaries by calling provider, storage, chart, analysis, trading, or domain services directly.
Agents must not treat planned surfaces as implemented.
Agents must distinguish shell-only dummy surfaces from operational surfaces.

id_conventions.stable_id_rule: Existing IDs are contracts. Rename only through an explicit migration phase.
id_conventions.object_id_rule: Qt object IDs, metadata IDs, and action IDs must remain deterministic and human readable.

ai_agent_usage.purpose: Allow future AI helpers to understand GUI structure and request safe GUI interactions without bypassing Leonardo ownership boundaries.
allowed: Reference stable window, object, and action IDs.
Request a GUI-open or GUI-click intent through approved GUI/action channels when permitted by the metadata.
Read shell status metadata when exposed by GUI.
forbidden: Direct mutation of GUI metadata or widgets.
Direct calls to Core registries or domain services to simulate GUI workflows.

notes: The default is read-only metadata access.
Direct mutation is always forbidden.
